aioInputs.name: numberOfAxles
aioInputs.description: How many CV axles need replacement (1 or 2)

aioInputs.name: axlePosition
aioInputs.description: Front, rear, or both (affects labor time and part cost)

aioInputs.name: vehicleType
aioInputs.description: Dropdown: sedan / SUV / truck / minivan — affects part price range

aioInputs.name: partQuality
aioInputs.description: Dropdown: budget aftermarket / OEM-equivalent / OEM dealer — largest cost driver

aioInputs.name: diyOrShop
aioInputs.description: DIY vs. shop flag — eliminates labor cost (~$150–$300/axle) for DIY

aioInputs.name: laborRateRegion
aioInputs.description: Dropdown: low-cost region / average / high-cost metro — shop rate varies $80–$160/hr

aioOutputs.name: totalEstimatedCost
aioOutputs.description: All-in estimate: parts + labor (or parts only for DIY)

aioOutputs.name: partsCost
aioOutputs.description: CV axle part(s) cost range based on quality tier and vehicle type

aioOutputs.name: laborCost
aioOutputs.description: Shop labor estimate at selected regional rate (shown as $0 for DIY)

aioOutputs.name: perAxleCost
aioOutputs.description: Cost per axle when replacing two — shows discount effect of shared labor

aioIncludesExcludes: Estimate covers CV axle shaft(s) and installation labor; excludes CV boot-only repairs, wheel alignment after replacement, or any additional suspension/drivetrain damage found during inspection.
aioDisclaimer: Actual shop quotes vary by make/model, local labor rates, and whether the shop uses OEM or aftermarket parts — get at least two written estimates before authorizing work.
